question: For each tile: are all the notes in the red box the same length in the print, and if not, which differ?
sean_words: For the four tiles, the first tile is two dotted quarters, and at the bottom there is a quarter note that's not dotted. For the second tile, it is three quarter notes with a half note on top. For the third tile, it's two half notes with a tremolo slash, but it also has a couple of accidentals, a sharp and a natural sign that are kind of in the square, in the red box. And four is just an eighth note with a P dynamic underneath it, as you thought.

tiles.sean: two dotted quarters, and at the bottom a quarter note that's not dotted
tiles.we_read: G3 quarter undotted; B-flat4, D5, G4 dotted quarters (four boxes for his three notes)

tiles.sean: three quarter notes with a half note on top
tiles.we_read: G3, B-flat4, D4 quarters; G5 half

tiles.sean: two half notes with a tremolo slash; a sharp and a natural sign also in the box
tiles.we_read: C4 eighth, F4 eighth, F5 half, F5 quarter (wrong)

tiles.sean: just an eighth note with a P dynamic underneath it
